title: Episode About the Sacrifice of Elder Sahibzadas

blocks.text: Inside Chamkaur the Singhs were left with almost no food or water, no arrows worth counting, and bodies worn down by unbroken fighting. (13–15)
Even in that condition they did not give way. At the Guru’s command they took up swords and guarded the fortress in pairs, stepping out one after another as the pressure shifted. (16–17)

When too many fell in that rotating defense, the Guru pulled the survivors back behind the walls, while the besieging forces kept storming forward with ladders, noise, dust, and repeated failed assaults. (18–21)
